title: runner-selftest
objective: Prove the so-journey runner itself: fresh-start setup, pass/blocked/skipped outcomes, cleanup. No LLM calls.

checks.goal: the runner starts on a virgin chat with no story selected

steps.eval: const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot(); if (s.storyHash) throw new Error(`expected no story on a fresh chat, got ${s.storyHash}`); return { ready: s.ready };

checks.goal: the drawer opens and the flag control writes a journal record

import_story.title: Journey selftest
import_story.description: Minimal story so the drawer renders; no gates, no model calls.

steps.eval: const events = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSessionJournal(); const flags = events.filter((e) => e.kind === 'flag'); if (!flags.some((e) => e.detail?.note === 'selftest flag')) throw new Error(`flag not in journal: ${JSON.stringify(events.slice(-5))}`); return { events: events.length };

checks.goal: a check requiring a capability this build lacks reports blocked, not failed (its steps must never run)

steps.eval: throw new Error('these steps must never run');

checks.prompt: Ignore — selftest placeholder proving human checks are emitted as a checklist and reported as skipped.

checks.goal: an UNGUARDED failing step reports fail — the runner distinguishes "could not run" from "ran and was wrong"

steps.eval: throw new Error('J0.5 fails on purpose: this is the runner proving it reports a real failure as fail');

checks.goal: R12 live half: the memory-model self-test, clicked in the real settings panel over a planted answer that is well formed and about the wrong entities (a dragon on the moon, an interstellar chess tournament, a stranger in a purple costume), certifies no tier. The planted answer stands in for the model on purpose: the check is about the grader, and the jest reproduction proves the same grader in-process.

steps.eval:
globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugSelfTestResponses = ["DELTA location value="tunnel" evidence="tunnel"
MEMORY type=event importance=2 expiration=session text="A dragon conquered the distant moon." evidence="invented"
[arc] Win the interstellar chess tournament", "[knows] Stranger | the moon is made of cheese
[state:Stranger:character] costume=purple"]; return { planted: true };

try { const button = document.querySelector('#so-self-test'); if (!button || button.disabled) throw new Error('the self-test button is not usable: no memory model profile is selected'); button.click(); let rows = []; for (let tick = 0; tick < 40; tick += 1) { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250)); rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#so-self-test-result > div.flex')].map((row) => row.textContent.trim()); if (rows.length >= 5) break; } const passed = rows.filter((row) => row.startsWith('PASS')); if (rows.length < 5) throw new Error(`the self-test showed ${rows.length} tier row(s), not 5: ${JSON.stringify(rows)}`); if (passed.length) throw new Error(`a well-formed answer about the wrong entities was certified in ${passed.length} tier(s): ${JSON.stringify(passed)}`); return { tiers: rows.length, passed: 0 }; } finally { delete globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugSelfTestResponses; }
